statement.zh: 迈锡尼城堡即历史人物阿伽门农的王都——荷马史诗人物历史化属假说。
statement.en: Mycenae as the historical capital of a person Agamemnon is epic historicization, not established fact.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
